Hi Sam —

Hope everything’s going well on your side. We’re wrapping up a short customer highlight program and I wanted to ask two quick favors:

1) Would you be willing to provide a 2–3 sentence public review on G2 about your experience with Redwood Inference? A link and a one-click flow makes it quick.

2) If you’re open to it, would you do a 15-minute reference call for a prospective buyer next week? We’ll keep it informal — just product fit, results you’ve seen, and any caveats.

To say thanks we offer a $50 Amazon e-gift card for reviews and we can route any reference logistics through your procurement team if that’s preferred. I’ve attached the quick instructions and the gift card terms.

If you’re game, I can send the G2 link and a calendar ping. No pressure either way — really appreciate your support.

Best,
